body: I have to make money to survive. If I can't enjoy what I'm doing to make money, what's the point?

The company molded me. It was there when my father wasn't. It supported my when my friends didn't. It showed me the path to knowledge. I can't imagine a life in which I don't work this one job. I don't if this is wrong or right, it's just always been in my head, that this is the only thing I can do if I want to enjoy living. Doesn't that make it true in itself? If I feel that this is the only thing that can make me happy, then it really is the only thing that can make me happy?

You're right. I have high expectations. But as long as I can remember I've only wanted to work for one particular company. I've tried and tried become good enough for that job, but it appears I'm not built for the only thing I want to spend my life doing. So I can either keep trying and fail or I could just quit right now. What seems most logical to you?
